description: Source code for MD5-HMAC cryptographic driver for Linux kernel, implementing hashing and HMAC functions with hardware acceleration support.

methods.name: md5_hmac_transform
methods.description: Saves input block to context, handles workaround for large data blocks.

methods.name: md5_hmac_setkey
methods.description: Sets the MD5 HMAC key, supports keys longer than 64 bytes by hashing.

methods.name: md5_hmac_setkey_hw
methods.description: Loads the HMAC key into hardware registers.

methods.name: md5_hmac_init
methods.description: Initializes the HMAC context before processing.

methods.name: md5_hmac_update
methods.description: Processes input data for HMAC computation.

methods.name: md5_hmac_final
methods.description: Finalizes HMAC computation, producing the hash output.

methods.name: md5_hmac_final_impl
methods.description: Performs the final or intermediate hash calculation, interacts with hardware.

methods.name: md5_hmac_exit_tfm
methods.description: Frees resources allocated for transformation context.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_md5_hmac
methods.description: Registers the MD5 HMAC driver with the kernel crypto API.
